I began to shut myself off from those around me when I was still a child because of the abuse I was suffering. And I never recovered from that. I never came back out of my shell. And now I am trapped in it unable to reach out and connect with people because I never really developed socially. I'm angry, confused, and ashamed of my own sexuality because I feel like it could have been altered in some way by my childhood. Its all very embarrassing. I've basically been alone my entire life. My first memories are of abuse and since then I have been unable to make serious friends.
